spec.file: 灵犀平台自然语言智能控制功能设计规范V1.4.docx

network.offline_guard: tests/test_offline_guard.py asserts zero socket connection attempts

fixes_this_round.issue: route_status null allowed micro/temporary actions (unknown treated as safe)
change: authority_contract.ROUTE_GATED_ACTIONS added; route_status promoted to core requirement

fixes_this_round.issue: system prompt taught manual hover as emergency_stop
change: cockpit.COCKPIT_SYSTEM_PROMPT: manual hover uses hover, never emergency_stop

follow_up_fixes_included.change: confirm() re-checks the path fence before the irreversible mapping-interruption gateway
fence providers split into hard-bounded / cooperative / unbounded; cooperative never enters the platform path
persistent SQLite mapping reservation makes the gateway at-most-once across processes

kept_interpretation_divergence.topic: V1.4 2.2.3 vs 4.1.1 for point_flight/point_orbit during a running auto route
kept_interpretation_divergence.decision: kept 4.1.1 temporary-task takeover semantics; not added to the 2.2.3 block set

tests.denominator_note: single denominator for all V1.4 docs and evidence; includes tests/test_offline_guard.py, which re-runs 1084 tests internally

python.compileall: python3 -m compileall -q src tests -> no output, exit 0

ui.note: historical read-only result from earlier the same day; not part of this closeout denominator

java.scope: platformsnapshot package only; other biz-inspection modules need MySQL/Redis
environment_notes: JAVA_HOME must be JDK 8; Corretto 21 breaks the old Lombok with TypeTag UNKNOWN
offline settings must declare osgeo and nexus-public repository ids and disable maven-default-http-blocker

scenarios.name: unknown_gateway_then_two_replays
scenarios.resolution: manual resolve_mapping_interruption(authority_ref) is the only way out

twenty_run_repeat.note: distribution varies with scheduling; the invariant is gateway/submit at most once

safety_checks.mapping_interruption_after_flight_action: no, atomic gateway runs before dispatch
safety_checks.cross_process_gateway_called_twice: no in measured runs; persistent reservation serializes it
safety_checks.cooperative_fence_provider_enters_platfo: no, rejected at assembly or degraded without calling

unit.proves: deterministic rules and state machines only

simulator.proves: in-memory execution loop; receipts carry execution_mode=simulator

fake_transport.proves: protocol shape and error paths; no real network wait

loopback_isolation.proves: local fake-Java protocol loop; not shared test/uat/prod

remaining_limits: real platform mapping atomic transaction not verified
real gateway support for idempotency keys not verified; supports_idempotency_key defaults to False
DNS resolution is not covered by socket timeout (getaddrinfo happens before open)
reservation at-most-once is verified on same-host SQLite only; cross-host consistency not verified
isolation tests, HTTP 2xx, submitted receipts and simulator accepted are never device success
device_effect is always not_verified and device_completion_verified() is always False

resource_cleanup.background_processes: none; all commands returned, subprocesses reaped

final_checks.no_secrets: no token, password, cookie or raw business payload written

git.rollback: forward revert of the listed files; no destructive git command used
